The 30-year Treasury bond yield, which is often impacted by geopolitical developments, was up 2 basis points at 5.275%. articles.title: Nvidia stock edges higher as investors weigh potential fallout of CEO's affair with alleged spy
articles.summary: Nvidia shares were slightly higher in premarket trading Tuesday as investors continued to weigh the potential fallout from CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Nvidia shares closed more than 4% lower on Monday, the day after Huang told staff in an email that he had been "unfaithful" to his wife and had "fallen short" of his responsibilities as CEO.

articles.title: France blames Iran for supermarket refrigerator cyberattacks, weighs sanctions
articles.summary: France is "not ruling anything out" in its response to October's mass cyberattacks on supermarket refrigerators that the country has blamed on Iran, the country's Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said on Tuesday. The French government summoned Iran's ambassador Tuesday morning after Paris said Monday that the findings of an investigation laid the blame for the hacks on Shahid Kaveh, an affiliate of the cyber unit of the powerful Revolutionary Guard Corps.

articles.title: China exports, imports soar past expectations in October — surplus narrows sharply
articles.summary: China's exports and imports surged more than expected in October, while its surplus shrank sharply, undershooting expectations even as it crossed $1 trillion for the year so far. articles.title: Trump administration proposes stricter work-search rules for unemployment benefits
articles.summary: The Labor Department proposed a rule on Monday that would raise the bar for people applying for unemployment insurance by requiring them to prove they've conducted five work-search activities per week in order to qualify for benefits. Currently, only four states require a minimum of five work searches per week, Michele Evermore, the senior director of economic security and worker transitions at the National Employment Law Project, wrote in an email.

articles.summary: Elizabeth Warren is set to take over the Senate Banking Committee. Among Warren's top issues for the Congress that convenes in January are addressing the cost of living, tightening export controls on advanced artificial intelligence chips to China and promulgating regulations for prediction markets, according to a Warren banking committee aide. The aide said Warren also intends to put constraints on AI chips going to China, while shaping rules for AI at home.

articles.title: Anthropic releases first frontier models since Amodei's call for slowdown as IPO buzz builds
articles.summary: Anthropic on Monday released two new artificial intelligence models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, as the company readies for a potentially historic IPO that could take place as soon as next week. The launch marks the first time that Anthropic has released so-called "frontier" models since its CEO, Dario Amodei, called to slow down the pace of AI development in September.

articles.title: A massive trade in Nvidia just went off – here are the details
articles.summary: The biggest options trade on Nvidia stock Monday seems to think the controversy swirling around the chip leader and its embattled CEO is creating a buying opportunity. In a trade about an hour after the opening bell that involved more than $100 million in options premium, someone exchanged an existing call spread for a more bullish position that captures the next five months of trading in Nvidia. In other words, it's a higher conviction trade that the chipmaker's stock will soon rebound.

articles.title: Goldman CEO Solomon says AI financing remains strong despite market jitters
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon told CNBC on Monday that financing demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure remains strong despite recent market jitters as investors reassess the risks involving the massive build-out. "There's still very strong demand for investments in the AI infrastructure build and the technology around the growth of AI," Solomon told CNBC's Leslie Picker.
